arxiv-2012-02224.title: Personality-Driven Gaze Animation with Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2012-02224.creator: F unda Durupinar
arxiv-2012-02224.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by F unda Durupinar. We present a generative adversarial learning approach to synthesize gaze behavior of a given personality. We train the model using an existing data set that comprises eye-tracking data and personality traits of 42 participants performing an everyday task. Given the values of Big-Five personality traits (openness, conscientiousness, extroversion, agreeableness, and neuroticism), our model generates time series data consisting of gaze target, blinking times, and pupil dimensions.

arxiv-2210-09610.title: Majorana corner states on the dice lattice
arxiv-2210-09610.creator: Narayan Mohanta, Rahul Soni, Satoshi Okamoto, Elbio Dagotto
arxiv-2210-09610.description: Abstract Lattice geometry continues providing exotic topological phases in condensed matter physics. Exciting recent examples are the higher-order topological phases, manifesting via localized lower-dimensional boundary states. Moreover, flat electronic bands with a non-trivial topology arise in various lattices and can hold a finite superfluid density, bounded by the Chern number C C .

arxiv-2303-07640.creator: s
arxiv-2303-07640.description: Abstract Bethe ansatz equations for spin- s Heisenberg spin chain with s\geq 1 are significantly more difficult to analyze than the spin- \tfrac{1}{2} case, due to the presence of repeated roots. As a result, it is challenging to derive extra conditions for the Bethe roots to be physical and study the related completeness problem.

arxiv-2404-00414.title: Chebyshev and The Fast Fourier Transform Methods for Signal Interpolation
arxiv-2404-00414.creator: Ishmael N. Amartey 1
arxiv-2404-00414.description: Abstract Approximation theorem is one of the most important aspects of numerical analysis that has evolved over the years with many different approaches. Some of the most popular approximation methods include the Lebesgue approximation theorem, the Weierstrass approximation, and the Fourier approximation theorem.

arxiv-2408-11441.title: Epistemic Injustice in Generative AI
arxiv-2408-11441.creator: Jackie Kay, Atoosa Kasirzadeh, Shakir Mohamed
arxiv-2408-11441.description: Abstract This paper investigates how generative AI can potentially undermine the integrity of collective knowledge and the processes we rely on to acquire, assess, and trust information, posing a significant threat to our knowledge ecosystem and democratic discourse. Grounded in social and political philosophy, we introduce the concept of generative algorithmic epistemic injustice .

arxiv-2510-19177.title: An XMM- Newton long look at the accretion disk plasma in the dipping neutron star LMXB 4U 1624–490
arxiv-2510-19177.creator: E. Caruso, E. Costantini, N. Degenaar, M. Díaz Trigo
arxiv-2510-19177.description: Abstract Context. Dipping neutron star low-mass X-ray binaries (NS LMXBs) are systems that exhibit periodic drops in their X-ray light curves. These are believed to be caused by material at the impact point of the gas stream onto the accretion disk, the bulge.

arxiv-2511-14650.title: AutoTool: Efficient Tool Selection for Large Language Model Agents
arxiv-2511-14650.creator: Jingyi Jia, Qinbin Li
arxiv-2511-14650.description: Abstract Large Language Model (LLM) agents have emerged as powerful tools for automating complex tasks by leveraging the reasoning and decision-making abilities of LLMs. However, a major bottleneck in current agent frameworks lies in the high inference cost of tool selection, especially in approaches like ReAct that repeatedly invoke the LLM to determine which tool to use at each step.

arxiv-2602-20706.title: Online Algorithms with Unreliable Guidance
arxiv-2602-20706.creator: Julien Dallot, Yuval Emek, Yuval Gil, Maciej Pacut, Stefan Schmid
arxiv-2602-20706.description: Abstract This paper introduces a new model for ML-augmented online decision making, called online algorithms with unreliable guidance (OAG) . This model completely separates between the predictive and algorithmic components, thus offering a single well-defined analysis framework that relies solely on the considered problem.

pmc-11630641.creator: Susmita Ghosh, Ali Ata Tuz, Martin Stenzel, Vikramjeet Singh, Mathis Richter, Oliver Soehnlein, Emanuel Lange, Robert Heyer, Zülal Cibir, Alexander Beer, Marcel Jung, Dennis Nagel, Dirk M. Hermann, Anja Hasenberg, Anika Grüneboom, Albert Sickmann, Matthias Gunzer

Studies investigated transcriptome of single-infiltrated neutrophils which could misinterpret molecular states of these post mitotic cells. However, neutrophil proteome characterization has been challenging due to low harvests from affected tissues.

pmc-11673789.title: Sclerostin and Cardiovascular Risk: Evaluating the Cardiovascular Safety of Romosozumab in Osteoporosis Treatment
pmc-11673789.creator: Shi-Hsun Chiu, Wen-Tien Wu, Ting-Kuo Yao, Cheng-Huan Peng, Kuang-Ting Yeh, Celestino Sardu
pmc-11673789.description: Background/Objectives: Osteoporosis and cardiovascular disease (CVD) share common risk factors and pathophysiological mechanisms, raising concerns about the cardiovascular implications of sclerostin inhibition. Romosozumab, a monoclonal antibody that targets sclerostin, is effective in increasing bone mineral density (BMD) and reducing fracture risk.

pmc-11710239.title: Identifying the regulatory cascade governing amyloid precursor protein macropinocytosis and subsequent production of amyloid‐beta
pmc-11710239.creator: Jordan M Krupa, Abdul Moiz Naqvi, Adrianna R Tsang, Claudia Seah, Stephen H Pasternak
pmc-11710239.description: BackgroundPreviously, we identified macropinocytosis as a novel mechanism for direct and rapid trafficking of cell surface APP to lysosomes, bypassing early and late endosomes. This process depends on the activity of Arf6 and several Rho‐GTPases, and inhibition of macropinocytosis reduces amyloid‐beta (Aβ) production. Macropinocytosis is relatively unstudied in neurons and neuronal cells.

pmc-13297345.title: Functional Group Chemistry Modulates Cellular Responses to Soluble Gelatin Derivatives Independent of Crosslinking
pmc-13297345.creator: Pekik Wiji Prasetyaningrum, Shinji Sakai
pmc-13297345.description: Gelatin functionalized with methacrylate (GelMA), norbornene (GelNB), and phenol (GelPH) has been studied as a precursor for crosslinkable biomaterials in tissue engineering. Cytocompatibility is usually assessed post-hydrogel formation, but cells briefly encounter soluble precursors during preparation and residual functional groups that may remain post-gelation. However, the biological effects of these uncrosslinked derivatives remain poorly understood.

pmc-13500832.title: Pictilisib and nutrient stress synergize to induce methuosis via PI(4,5)P2-dependent macropinocytic dysregulation in cancer cells
pmc-13500832.creator: Xuefei Wang, Xiaolin Sang, Yuemei Wen, Xingming Liao, Jiao Liu, Tiezheng Zheng, Tianming Xing, Min Wang, Dong An, Xining Zhang, Xiuling Li, Xinmiao Liang, Pixu Liu, Hailing Cheng
pmc-13500832.description: Aberrant phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K) activation drives many cancers, but PI3K inhibitors like Pictilisib often induce cytostasis rather than cytotoxicity, limiting their therapeutic potential. Here we demonstrate that PI3K inhibition combined with nutrient stress triggers methuosis, a non-apoptotic form of programmed cell death characterized by dysregulated macropinosomes.

pmc-13583947.title: An LLM-enhanced AI agent for rapid diagnosis of acute aortic dissection in multi-center settings
pmc-13583947.creator: Hunian Li, Yuchen Pei, Tao Hu, Xiaoyu Hu, Jiazhen Luo, Manli Zhu, Jie Li, Yutao Ma, Li Yan
pmc-13583947.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryAcute aortic dissection (AAD) is a high-mortality cardiovascular emergency, yet early diagnosis before computed tomography angiography (CTA) remains challenging. We developed AAD-Agent as a pre-imaging triage aid—not as a replacement for CTA—and evaluated it in a retrospective, multi-center study. Using 869 suspected patients from 3 Chinese hospitals for internal validation and 200 from 2 additional hospitals for external validation, we compared AAD-Agent against a machine learning (ML) ensemble model.
